credits_text: featuring deleted scenes and commentary by the makers of "The Bag Witch Project"
other_text: How far can you take a parody? Pretty far, I guess. In August 1998, three roleplayers disappeared in a hotel in Milwaukee, Wisconsin while looking for a gaming tournament... A year later, their footage was found.
